candidate_evidence.quote: patients will receive 1-3 image-guided biopsies within tumor tissue already designated for resection or removal.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed, suspected or recurrent glioblastoma (GBM) patients with enhancing tumors greater than 1.5 mL clinically indicated for surgical resection.

source_quote.quote: I. DCN immunohistochemistry (IHC), in-situ hybridization (ISH), and RNA expression within the tumor will be linearly correlated with continuous values of diffusion measurements (ADCL).

coder_notes: MRI and biospecimen study with no drug intervention; bevacizumab is mentioned only in the background summary and is not a registered intervention.
